_about: Snowflake AI credits per million tokens, keyed by the name the provider uses. Source: Snowflake Service Consumption Table, effective 2026-11-04, Table 6(b) Cortex Inference with Prompt Caching. input is uncached input; cached_input is a cache read; cache_write is a cache write (a model without one pays input for it). The ledger's input count includes cached and cache-write tokens, so uncached = input - cached - cache_write.
source: Snowflake Service Consumption Table, effective 2026-11-04, Table 6(b)
usd_per_credit_is: an assumption, not a quoted price: change it here and every dollar figure follows
